errors.evidence: The description states that the lines have different styles and colors, but all three lines in the chart are the same color (grey).

errors.text_span: Линията на Търговията започва при 56.5% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the starting value for the 'Търговия' (Trade) line. The solid line for 'Търговия' actually starts at approximately 59.5% in 2004, not 56.5%.

errors.text_span: Линията на Вноса започва при 65.5% през 2004 г., достига връх от 62.5% през 2009 г., след което се покачва до 63.5% през 2012 г. и намалява до 61.5% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the 'Внос' (Imports) line is incorrect. The actual 'Внос' line (short dashes) starts at ~57% in 2004 and ends at ~63% in 2019. The values and trends mentioned in the description (starting at 65.5%, peaking at 62.5% in 2009, etc.) do not correspond to any of the lines in the chart.

errors.text_span: Линията на Износа започва при 54.5% през 2004 г., достига връх от 66.5% през 2016 г., след което намалява до 62.5% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Износ' (Exports) line is almost entirely incorrect. The actual 'Износ' line (long dashes) starts at ~62.5% in 2004 (not 54.5%), reaches its peak of ~66.5% in 2018 (not 2016), and ends at ~66% in 2019 (not 62.5%). The machine seems to have confused the data series.

errors.text_span: Всички линии имат забележителни колебания през годините, но без да могат да бъдат направени изводи за причините.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an interpretation ('забележителни колебания' - remarkable fluctuations) and meta-commentary ('без да могат да бъдат направени изводи за причините' - but no conclusions can be drawn about the causes), which goes beyond a direct description of the visual data.

The description mentions that the lines have different styles but fails to specify what those styles are (e.g., solid, short-dashed, long-dashed) to allow a user to distinguish between 'Търговия', 'Внос', and 'Износ'.
